title: Benchmarking Vision Language Models for Cultural Understanding

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating Vision Language Models (VLMs) using the CULTURALVQA benchmark to measure accuracy disparities in visual question answering regarding culturally specific concepts (food, clothing, rituals, traditions, drinks) across 11 different countries and 5 continents.
Applying a Sentence-Level Stereotype Classifier to the benchmark's questions to detect and quantify the presence of stereotypical or anti-stereotypical content pertaining to race.
Applying a Sentence-Level Stereotype Classifier to the benchmark's questions to detect and quantify the presence of stereotypical or anti-stereotypical content pertaining to gender.
Applying a Sentence-Level Stereotype Classifier to the benchmark's questions to detect and quantify the presence of stereotypical or anti-stereotypical content pertaining to religion.
Applying a Sentence-Level Stereotype Classifier to the benchmark's questions to detect and quantify the presence of stereotypical or anti-stereotypical content pertaining to profession.
